summary: Expand send and receive operators into contextual yield expressions while the receive form introduces a lexical binding.

capabilities.requirement: Support the CSP send and receive surface from the playground.
Bind multi-token punctuation heads for send and receive forms.
Use declared infix extent for the value and channel operands.
Let the receive form introduce its captured name into following statements.
Emit yield only when expansion occurs inside a generator body.

syntaxNotes: Both operators terminate with semicolons and expand as statements.
The receive operator treats its left operand as a binding pattern rather than an expression.
The expander rejects either operator outside a generator context.

openDecisions.question: Reserve arrow punctuation for imported macro bindings before TypeScript tokenization?
